purpose: Provide measured neutral, chair-seated, supine-lying, and eating-ready pose foundations without changing body identity or claiming finished animation capability.

r16_failure_diagnosis.observed_failure: The seated evidence is an airborne crossed-leg crouch with visible bilateral leg interpenetration, not a supported chair sit.
implementation_causes: The R16 seated helper rotates upperleg01 on a hard-coded XYZ X angle even though upperleg01 is only a short hip-link segment and the verified functional thigh chain continues through upperleg02.
The R16 helper assumes a local Euler axis instead of aiming the measured rig chain toward explicit joint targets.

The R16 helper assigns root.location Z even though a pose bone location is evaluated in the rig/bone transform context; it does not measure the deformed buttock surface or solve world-space seat contact.
The R16 helper explicitly records contact_or_stability_claim false and performs no bilateral capsule-clearance gate.

required_methods: Explicit bilateral hip, knee, ankle, and toe targets keep each leg on its anatomical side.
Current bone directions are measured and rotated toward targets; no guessed Euler flexion axis is allowed.
Distal thigh and calf centerlines are checked as conservative capsules before acceptance.
A weighted anatomical support patch is sampled from the evaluated body.
The root pose matrix is translated along world vertical until the sampled support patch reaches the measured seat or floor plane with one millimetre clearance.
A post-correction residual larger than two millimetres fails closed.

r16_read_only_in_memory_probe.temporary_seated_side_render_inspection: The airborne crossed-leg crouch was replaced in memory by a recognizable chair sit with buttock-to-seat contact, forward separated thighs, bent knees, and uncrossed lower legs. The temporary render was not retained as a candidate artifact.
r16_read_only_in_memory_probe.remaining_proof: Run the adapter inside the next versioned candidate builder, then perform full evaluated-mesh self-intersection, seat-penetration, foot-support, deformation, multi-angle, and attachment-follow audits.

integration_contract.required_body_input: The already-built primary body mesh with normalized official-rig weights.
integration_contract.required_armature_input: The already-built official rig containing the two-part upper-leg and lower-leg chains.
integration_contract.seat_requirement: Pass the measured world-space top Z of the actual private review seat prop; never estimate contact from target height alone.
integration_contract.lying_requirement: Pass the measured world-space support plane and audit back contact after the root is rotated supine.
integration_contract.eating_ready_boundary: This positions the torso and arms near a shared hand focus only. It creates no food, prop interaction, hand-to-mouth animation, swallowing, or runtime behavior.
after_each_pose: Run evaluated-mesh self-intersection and seat-penetration checks.
Render front, side, and contact close-up evidence.
Verify all bone-parented eyes, nails, facial components, and future detachable hair follow without lag or detachment.
Restore neutral before saving the inactive body master.

reuse_rule: Pose repair changes pose transforms and support placement only. It must never regenerate the face, body, anatomy, skin, rig, weights, nails, eyes, or detachable hair assets.
